segments.mil7.7.5:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena, ‘rukkhassa tīṇi aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.7.5:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena vimuttipupphasāmaññaphaladhārinā bhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.7.5:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, rukkhassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.7.5:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, rukkho upagatānamanuppaviṭṭhānaṃ janānaṃ chāyaṃ deti,
segments.mil7.7.5:2.2: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena upagatānamanuppaviṭṭhānaṃ puggalānaṃ āmisappaṭisandhārena vā dhammappaṭisanthārena vā paṭisantharitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.7.5:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, rukkhassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.7.5:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, rukkho chāyāvemattaṃ na karoti,
segments.mil7.7.5:3.2: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena sabbasattesu vemattatā na kātabbā, coravadhakapaccatthikesupi attanipi samasamā mettābhāvanā kātabbā, ‘kinti ime sattā averā abyāpajjā [abyāpajjhā (sī.)] anīghā sukhī attānaṃ parihareyyu’nti.
segments.mil7.7.5:3.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, rukkhassa tatiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
